## AI error handler: diagnose any workflow failure and alert Slack in plain language

### How it works
Set this one workflow as the Error Workflow for all your other workflows and it becomes a shared safety net. Whenever any workflow fails, the Error Trigger fires with the execution details. A Code node pulls out the workflow name, the failed node and the error message, and a Basic LLM Chain with Google Gemini diagnoses it: it categorises the failure (auth, rate limit, timeout, bad data, expression error and so on), rates the severity, explains in one plain sentence what went wrong, names the likely cause, and suggests a concrete fix in n8n terms. Every failure is logged to a Google Sheet so you can spot patterns, and a Slack alert is posted with the diagnosis and a direct link to the failed execution. If the AI itself is unavailable, the raw error is still logged and alerted.

### Setup
1. Connect Google Gemini (PaLM) API, Google Sheets and Slack.
2. Point the Log Error node at your spreadsheet (tab: Errors) and pick a Slack channel.
3. In each workflow you want covered, set Settings > Error Workflow to this one.

### Customization tips
Route high-severity errors to PagerDuty, or only alert when the same workflow fails twice.

## 1. Catch the failure
The Error Trigger fires when any workflow that points here fails. A Code node extracts the workflow, node and error.

## 2. Diagnose (Basic LLM Chain)
Gemini categorises the error, rates severity, and suggests a concrete fix in plain language. Fails soft to the raw error.

## 3. Log & alert
Log every failure to Sheets and post a Slack alert with the diagnosis and a link to the execution.
